2. Due dates for filing of Income Tax Returns and Audit Reports for AY 2026-27 are extended in the cases of persons mentioned at Sl.No.2 in the Table below Explanation2 to Sub-section (1) of Section 139 of Income Tax Act 1961 vide Circular No.07/2026 dated 28th September,2026.
3. Form 1 under the “Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers Disclosure Scheme” is now available for filing.
4. ITR-1, ITR-2, ITR-3, ITR-4, ITR-5, ITR-6 and ITR-7 for AY 2026-27 are available for filing through both online and offline utilities.
5. Filing of TDS/TCS Correction Statements pertaining to Tax Year 2026-27 has been enabled.

6. Demand Management Facilitation Centre (DFC), has been set up to guide Taxpayers on issues/grievances regarding their outstanding demands. DFC may be contacted through the e-mail id: taxdemand@cpc.incometax.gov.in or on the toll-free number - 1800 309 0131 or chargeable no. 0821-6671200.
7. Excel utilities for filing Updated return for ITR-1 to 7 for AY 2022-23 as per Finance Act, 2026 are available for filing !

Role of an ROC Filing Consultant
An ROC Filing Consultant is responsible for assisting businesses in filing mandatory returns and documents within the prescribed time. Their key responsibilities include:
: Helping businesses register under the Companies Act, 2013, and ensuring compliance with initial documentation.
: Assisting in filing and  with the ROC.
: Ensuring timely submission of forms for changes in the company’s structure, such as directorship modifications, share allotments, and capital alterations.
: Providing guidance on corporate governance, statutory requirements, and best practices.
: Addressing queries or compliance notices from the ROC effectively to avoid legal repercussions.
: Keeping updated records as per legal norms, including registers of members, charges, and directors.
: Communicating with the ROC and MCA on behalf of the company for smooth compliance.
Failing to comply with ROC filing requirements can lead to severe consequences, including penalties, fines, or even disqualification of directors. Here’s why ROC filing is crucial:
: Non-compliance results in hefty fines and legal actions.
: Proper filing ensures transparency in financial matters.
: A compliant company gains trust among investors and stakeholders.
: Timely filings prevent legal disruptions that can impact business operations.
